name: 910 Race 2026 (910Nineten Race)
short_description: The 910 Race 2026 is a half-marathon, 10K, and 5K event held October 11, 2026 at ICE BSD, Tangerang, Indonesia.
ai_summary: The 910 Race 2026 is a half-marathon event organised by Indonesian running-shoe brand 910 Nineten, scheduled for October 11, 2026 at ICE BSD in BSD City, Tangerang, Banten, Indonesia. Runners can choose from three distances: a half marathon the organiser gives as 21.195 km, 10 km and 5 km. Regular prices are IDR 679,000 for the half marathon, IDR 479,000 for the 10K and IDR 379,000 for the 5K.

core_facts.venue: ICE BSD (Indonesia Convention Exhibition), BSD City

pros: Wide, flat roads through BSD City, with two flyovers as the only climbs
Chip timing, with prizes five deep for men and women in each race
Cut-offs of 1 hour for the 5 km, 2 hours for the 10 km and 3 hours 30 for the half
A 1:22:56 half marathon was enough for a top-five place in 2025
cons: Humid mornings: 25°C and 89% humidity at 5am in 2025, 30°C by 9am
Race packs were collected at fX Sudirman in central Jakarta, not at the BSD venue
No route map or aid-station plan in the 2025 listing
In 2025 entries were sold only through the brand's app, one per account

excerpt_quotes.quote: Rute lomba melintasi kawasan BSD yang asri. Jalannya lebar dan datar, memberi kenyamanan sekaligus tantangan tersendiri dengan dua jembatan layang yang menguji stamina para peserta.
excerpt_quotes.attribution: IDN Times race recap of 910Nineten Race 2025

excerpt_quotes.quote: Rute lomba melintasi kawasan BSD yang asri dengan penonton bersorak memberi semangat dan fotografer menangkap setiap momen pelari.
excerpt_quotes.attribution: IDN Times race recap of 910Nineten Race 2025

excerpt_quotes.quote: Lintasan yang lebar, datar, dan tertata rapi memberikan pengalaman berlari yang nyaman, namun tetap menantang berkat keberadaan dua jembatan layang di sepanjang rute.
excerpt_quotes.attribution: Cerita Pelari news report on the inaugural 910Nineten Race 2025

research_highlights: Course runs through BSD City and is described in race-day coverage as wide and flat, but includes two elevated flyover bridges that add a climbing challenge for runners.
2026 event is the second edition, held at the same venue (ICE BSD, Tangerang) and using the same three-category format (5K, 10K, Half Marathon) as the 2025 debut.
Cut-off times reported for the 2026 edition: 5K – 1 hour, 10K – 2 hours, Half Marathon – 3 hours 30 minutes, with early-morning flag-offs between 5:00–5:30 WIB.
The inaugural 2025 edition drew roughly 2,000–2,500 runners; organizers are targeting over 3,000 participants for the 2026 edition.

faqs.question: When is the 910 Race 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: The 910 Race 2026 is scheduled to take place on October 11, 2026. The event will be held at ICE BSD, which is the Indonesia Convention Exhibition center located in BSD City, within Tangerang, Banten, Indonesia.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at the 910 Race 2026?
faqs.answer: The 910 Race 2026 offers three distance options for participants to choose from: a half marathon that the organiser lists as 21.195 km, a 10 km race and a shorter 5 km race, allowing runners of varying experience levels to take part in the event.

faqs.question: How much does registration cost?
faqs.answer: Regular registration pricing for the 910 Race 2026 is set at IDR 679,000 for the half-marathon distance, IDR 479,000 for the 10K race, and IDR 379,000 for the 5K race, according to the provided pricing information.

faqs.question: Who organizes the 910 Race 2026?
faqs.answer: The 910 Race 2026 is organized by 910 Nineten, which is an Indonesian running-shoe brand. The event takes place at ICE BSD in BSD City, located in Tangerang, Banten, Indonesia.
